summary: This is a story in 2005. Christy Lam is a typical city girl born and raised in Hong Kong. She is a month from turning 30, and has just begun to cope with the same struggles shared by most girls of the same age: the almost unbearable stress at work, her aging but annoying parents, and her seemingly stable yet stagnant relationship. All of these only add to her fear for this next chapter of her life. Wong Tin-Lok, on the other hand, is also turning 30 soon, but leads a vastly different life. She has never been in love, and her job is taking her nowhere. And yet, she has always kept an optimistic attitude towards life. On the verge of her next chapter, she makes a bold decision to just pick up her bags and fulfill her childhood dream. They have never met each other, and their personalities are night and day. But as fate would have it, Christy makes a temporary move into Wong's apartment

Release your limiting beliefs, learn to love yourself unconditionally, and heal all wounds—bring yourself home. When you're willing to let go of the fear and lack rooted in the ego, you can connect with the love and compassion of your higher self

title: திருநெல்வேலி எழுச்சியும் வ.உ.சி.யும் 1908 | tirunelveeli ezucciyum vaa.vuu.ci.yum 1908
author: Venkatacalapati, A. Ira., 1967-
summary: This book explores the significant uprising in Tamil Nadu during India's freedom struggle, focusing on the influential leader V. O. Chidambaram Pillai (V. O. C). Known for challenging British colonial rule by operating a shipping company, V. O. C.'s arrest led to widespread protests in Tirunelveli and Tuticorin, where people took to the streets, organized strikes, and damaged government property. The British government responded forcefully, resulting in several deaths and numerous arrests, and imposed martial law for six months. This book provides a detailed account of the uprising, its background, and its impact, highlighting V. O. C.'s role and the contributions of many ordinary people. Written by A. R. Venkatachalapathy, it combines thorough research with engaging storytelling to bring this pivotal event in Tamil Nadu's history to life.
